reference: independent numpy implementation of EHT (STO-nG overlap, Wolfsberg-Helmholtz Hamiltonian, generalized eigenproblem); parameters read from sci-form's src/eht/params.rs (transcribed from Hoffmann 1960 / Alvarez 1993)

conventions.overlap_diagonal: S_ii = 1 (Extended-Huckel convention: the valence orbitals are normalised); 'overlap_true_diagonal' reports the integral of the unnormalised STO-nG contraction for reference
